extract_state_dict: extract a dictionary of field values from a dataclass instance using get_state_dict
serialize_field_values: serialize field values including dataclasses, enums, lists, and dicts to JSON-compatible format
load_state_into_instance: load field values from a dictionary into a dataclass instance using load_state_dict
convert_dict_to_dataclass: convert a dictionary into a dataclass instance with nested dataclasses and enums using from_dict
deserialize_dynamic_data: recursively deserialize data into a specified type including dataclasses, lists, and dicts using deserialize_dynamic
